reply:
**Margin Table** is a launch package for a book club that gathers at a different independent café each month. The kickoff is **Wednesday, March 10, 2027, from 6:30 to 7:30 p.m.** Everyone brings a short passage from a book they chose. Guests can read it aloud, ask someone to read it for them, or simply listen.

| Artifact | How to use it |
|---|---|
| [Invitation maker](./Customize-invitation.html) | Open locally, enter the café name, address, and RSVP contact, then print or save a PNG. Works offline. |
| [Printable invitation](./Invitation.pdf) | Print a US Letter flyer and fill in the venue and RSVP details by hand. |
| [Share card](./Share-card.png) | Send this image to potential participants. It directs them to ask the organizer for the address and a seat. |
| [Host guide](./Host-guide.pdf) | Run the hour with a welcome script, timed reading turns, and a discussion prompt. The 16-seat count includes the host. |
| [Reading cards](./Reading-cards.pdf) | Print four copies and cut along the guides for 16 cards. Guests can mark their passage and quietly note a line they want to remember. |

I verified the kickoff date, checked the print layouts, and tested the invitation maker’s venue fields and PNG generation.
